blocking_findings.title: Delegation-chain inequality does not prove preserved delegation-overlap absence
blocking_findings.evidence: V5 binds only delegation_chain_sha256 and requires unequal hashes in each six-dimension comparison. Distinct full-chain hashes do not prove that two chains share no actor, principal, delegator or edge, while the preserved V4 conflict semantic requires delegation_overlap_absent. Minimal successor repair: bind canonical typed delegation-chain members or edges and derive an exact disjointness proof for all 153 operational and 18 auditor-role comparisons; retain the whole-chain hash only as an integrity binding.

blocking_findings.title: Incident receipts can bind two conflicting process-start histories
blocking_findings.evidence: INCIDENT_RECEIPT_V5 adds a required process_start_outcome while CHECKPOINT_LEDGER_V5 separately carries process_start_outcome_or_null. Neither the override conditional nor cross-reference rule requires exact equality at or after C5 or the exact null versus NOT_CALLED pairing before C5. Minimal successor repair: use one authoritative object, or freeze a phase-conditional exact byte-equality/null join and reject every conflict.

blocking_findings.title: Thirteen V5 incident triggers are not preauthorized
blocking_findings.evidence: V5 receipts use fourteen new trigger IDs, but the effective registry retains unchanged INCIDENT_AUTHORIZATION_V4 with its old eight-token authorized_trigger_states. Only ILLEGAL_SPLIT_STATE is shared; thirteen V5 triggers therefore have no preworker authorization. Minimal successor repair: define INCIDENT_AUTHORIZATION_V6/V5-successor with the exact new trigger array, replace it in the effective registry and Root projection, update all refs, and add the exact supersession pointer without reinterpreting V4.

blocking_findings.title: P4 explicit unchanged failure has no matching legal state predicate
blocking_findings.evidence: P4 maps all five non-success tokens, including EXPLICIT_FAILURE_PROVEN_NO_MUTATION, to PUBLICATION_ATTESTATION_RENAME_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN_SPENT. That state's predicate requires attestation absence/presence/identity to be unprovable, which conflicts with an explicit failure whose unchanged state is proven. Minimal successor repair: add a distinct explicit-failure state or broaden and formally partition the predicate so every P4 token matches exactly one truthful state.

blocking_findings.title: Checkpoint ledgers do not constrain last-completed and first-failed adjacency
blocking_findings.evidence: CHECKPOINT_LEDGER_V5 has separate last_completed_checkpoint_or_none and first_failed_checkpoint_or_null fields but no exact predecessor relation, including branch-specific P2S/P2F to P3. Impossible histories can satisfy the individual enums and Boolean assertions. Minimal successor repair: freeze the exact predecessor/transition table, join both fields and selected branch to one row, and verify reachability, totality and no later checkpoint after failure.

blocking_findings.title: Publication attestation circularly claims the later P5 validation
blocking_findings.evidence: The V5 publication-attestation override requires checkpoint_ledger to show P5 completed with null failure. Under the inherited and explicitly preserved P1-P5 order, the attestation is constructed and published at P4 and only then validated at P5. It cannot truthfully hash-bind its own future validation. Minimal successor repair: limit the attestation ledger to observations completed before its bytes are finalized, and record P5 in a distinct later immutable validation artifact or downstream audit.

blocking_findings.title: V5 flush observations do not prove the complete required flush plan
blocking_findings.evidence: ACCESS_ATTESTATION_V5 forces inherited flush observations empty, but the replacement publication array has only minimum one row and the incident array may be empty. No exact branch/phase required-path and repeated-call order, first-failure prefix, or no-later-call rule is bound. The inherited quarantine-parent SUCCESS_DURABLE field is also not joined to a unique V5 row. Minimal successor repair: freeze an exact branch-specific call plan, require one ordered observation per attempted/required call with prefix failure semantics, and derive every durability scalar from its unique matching observation.
